text: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局城市司首席统计师董莉娟：从同比看，全国CPI上涨0.5%，保持温和上涨。CPI同比涨幅比上月回落0.5个百分点，主要是受汽油价格涨幅回落影响。汽油价格上涨1.0%，涨幅比上月回落16.0个百分点，对CPI的上拉影响比上月减少约0.45个百分点，带动能源价格涨幅回落至0.6%。扣除能源的工业消费品价格上涨1.5%，涨幅比上月回落0.2个百分点，影响CPI同比上涨约0.37个百分点。其中，黄金饰品、个人护理用品和家用器具价格分别上涨24.6%、1.7%和0.2%，涨幅均有回落，合计影响CPI同比上涨约0.13个百分
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 9 - NBS Chief Statistician of the Urban Department Dong Lijuan: Year-on-year, the national CPI rose 0.5%, maintaining a moderate increase. The year-on-year CPI increase fell 0.5 percentage points from the previous month, mainly due to the narrowing rise in gasoline prices. Gasoline prices rose 1.0%, with the increase down 16.0 percentage points from the previous month, contributing about 0.45 percentage points less to the CPI than the previous month, pulling the energy price increase down to 0.6%. Industrial consumer goods excluding energy rose 1.5%, with the increase down 0.2 percentage points from the previous month, contributing about 0.37 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase. Among them, gold jewelry, personal care supplies, and household appliances rose 24.6%, 1.7%, and 0.2% respectively, with all increases narrowing, together contributing about 0.13 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase.
